## [Unreleased]

### ✨ Features

- Initial release of ktestify-plugin-http: synchronous HTTP request/response transport, endpoint registration, bearer token support, status/body/header assertions, and the eventually-consistent polling step, built entirely on `ktestify-core`'s new `RequestResponseClient` / `AbstractSynchronousConsumer` / `AttributeRecordMatcher` contracts.
